purpose: Fix the turnover-shock continuation candidate and validate daily OHLCV coverage and point-in-time session mapping before any separately authorized performance study.

hypothesis.mechanism: An unusually high completed daily turnover proxy may reflect information arrival or temporary liquidity demand.

fixed_universe.name: turnover_shock_candidate_2026_09_27
fixed_universe.selection_rule: The complete ex-ante fixed list; no symbols may be added, removed, or replaced based on outcomes.

study_window.meaning: Fixed coverage acquisition bound only; this is not a performance or holdout partition.

coverage_contract.source: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint through data.yahoo_loader.load_yahoo_history

point_in_time_contract.signal_uses_only: The completed signal-day bar and the preceding 20 completed daily bars.
point_in_time_contract.trade_calendar_mapping: First XNYS session strictly after signal_day.

decision_rule: COVERAGE_VALIDATED requires a complete aligned frozen snapshot, finite positive closes and volumes, XNYS session continuity, strictly subsequent next-session calendar mapping, and reproducible source-vintage provenance. Incomplete coverage or unavailable source-vintage provenance returns DATA_INSUFFICIENT; structural/data-contract or PIT failures return DATA_INVALID. Stop without performance evaluation on either failure status. Any future performance study requires separate authorization and a new preregistration.
